Additional comments:

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer:
I took the following economic courses:
Financial Economics I
Advanced Microeconomics - game theory
Markets, Competition and Strategy

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: They were all 300 level. Which is for 3rd year undergrad students.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: I strongly disliked the style of teaching. They basically teach you (and reward you) to become a human calculator. A lot of the students seemed to have no idea about pretty simple economic intuitions. In other words, the most useful aspects (i.e., what you can use after your studies) of economics were disregarded, in my opinion.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Financial Economics I (FE)
Advanced Microeconomics - game theory (AM)
Markets, Competition and Strategy (MCS)
Introductory Philosophy of Science (IPS)

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
IPS is pretty easy to pass and the workload is not too bad.
I would not recommend MCS - no focus on intuition.
FI is a decent course and was without a doubt my favorite course. 
AM has a very small workload but is relatively difficult to get a good grade. Did not learn anything I can apply to the real world.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer:
Extended weekend ideas (3-5 days):
Algonquin National Park
New York City
Banff National Park
Montreal
Great Smoky Mountains (Tennessee) - an option when it is too cold to go to Banff or Yellowstone

Day trips:
Toronto nightlife is decent - King Street West, Queen Street West or maybe College Street.
Go to the Islands just outside of Toronto.
Watch some sports - NBA, MLS, NHL or MLB
Just walk around Toronto

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Reach out to some of the other Danes (can be difficult to meet non-exchange students)
Get some decent housing
Use your weekends to get out of the city. A lot of beautiful nature within driving or flying distance.
